"""Limited-mode RoboWits ball_into_bottle episode controller.
Run this script with a command argument for one sequential stage; it always reconnects
through the persistent service and never resets the episode.
"""
import sys, json, pathlib, time
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver

OUT=pathlib.Path('/app/output'); RUNS=pathlib.Path('/app/runs')
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True); RUNS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
r=Robot()

def observe(tag, depth=True):
    o=r.get_obs(depth=depth, video='none')
    o.save(str(RUNS/tag))
    from PIL import Image
    for c,a in o.last.items(): Image.fromarray(a).save(OUT/f'{tag}_{c}.png')
    if depth:
        for c,a in o.last_depth.items(): np.save(OUT/f'{tag}_depth_{c}.npy',a)
    print(json.dumps({'tag':tag,'meta':o.meta,'tcp_pose':o.meta['proprio']['now'][16:30]},indent=2))
    return o

def posepath(arm, waypoints, counts=None, dt=0.1, note=''):
    """waypoints: (xyz, quaternion_wxyz, opening) target list; inserts cartesian-linear rows."""
    o=r.get_obs(video='none')
    now=np.asarray(o.meta['proprio']['now'],float)
    cur=np.r_[now[16:23],now[7]] if arm=='right' else np.r_[now[23:30],now[15]]
    holdr=np.r_[now[16:23],now[7]]
    holdl=np.r_[now[23:30],now[15]]
    curpose=cur[:7].copy(); curopen=cur[7]
    if counts is None: counts=[10]*len(waypoints)
    rows=[]
    for (xyz,q,opening),n in zip(waypoints,counts):
        end=np.r_[xyz,q]
        # use normalized sign-consistent quaternion interpolation to keep every IK target valid.
        qa=curpose[3:7]/np.linalg.norm(curpose[3:7]); qb=np.asarray(q,float)/np.linalg.norm(q)
        if qa@qb<0: qb=-qb
        for i in range(1,n+1):
            a=i/n; xyz_i=(1-a)*curpose[:3]+a*np.asarray(xyz,float)
            qi=(1-a)*qa+a*qb; qi/=np.linalg.norm(qi)
            op=(1-a)*curopen+a*opening
            ep=np.r_[xyz_i,qi,op]
            row=np.r_[ep,holdl] if arm=='right' else np.r_[holdr,ep]
            rows.append(row)
        curpose=end.copy(); curopen=opening
    rows=np.asarray(rows,float)
    res=r.submit('ee_pose',rows,dt=dt,video='none',note=note)
    print('submit',json.dumps(res.meta,indent=2))
    res.save(str(RUNS/f'cmd_{int(time.time())}'))
    return res

cmd=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'observe'
if cmd=='observe': observe('current')
elif cmd=='above_cup':
    o=r.get_obs(video='none'); now=np.asarray(o.meta['proprio']['now'],float)
    q=now[26:30].copy()
    # Raise vertically before translating leftward toward the cup.
    posepath('left', [([now[23],now[24],now[25]+.19],q,.09),([.635,.05,1.08],q,.09)], [8,14], note='left arm hover above blue cup')
    observe('hover_cup')
elif cmd=='custom':
    # xyz q(wxyz) opening, arm passed as argv[2]; JSON pose list as argv[3].
    arm=sys.argv[2]; targets=json.loads(sys.argv[3]); cur=[]
    for x in targets: cur.append((x[:3],x[3:7],x[7]))
    posepath(arm,cur,note='custom cartesian motion'); observe('custom_result')
else: raise SystemExit('unknown command '+cmd)
